page.overview:
Who is India?

India is a female baby Velociraptor. She can be seen within the Jurassic World: A Journey Through the Eras attraction at Universal Studios Hollywood between April 23 through May 19, 2026. She is the sister of Tango, Bravo and Sierra.

Like Lima, India's color pattern appears similar to Delta and Sierra.
